description: This file defines the WorkflowReminderRepository class with static methods for interacting with workflow reminder data in a database using Prisma ORM. It includes methods for retrieving, deleting, and updating workflow reminders, as well as fetching reminders for specific workflow steps and AI phone call execution.

classes.name: WorkflowReminderRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing static methods for managing workflow reminders in the database.

methods.name: getFutureScheduledAttendeeSMSReminders
methods.description: Retrieves future scheduled SMS reminders for attendees based on phone number.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowReminders
methods.description: Deletes workflow reminders by their IDs.

methods.name: findWorkflowRemindersByStepId
methods.description: Finds workflow reminders associated with a specific workflow step ID.

methods.name: findWorkflowRemindersByStepIds
methods.description: Finds workflow reminders associated with multiple workflow step IDs.

methods.name: findWorkflowReminderForAIPhoneCallExecution
methods.description: Fetches detailed workflow reminder data for AI phone call execution, including booking and attendee info.

methods.name: updateWorkflowReminderReferenceAndScheduled
methods.description: Updates the reference ID and scheduled status of a workflow reminder.
